checks.title: Confirm the experiment job and owners
checks.instructions: Name the exact experiment, decision owner, rollout and rollback owners, measurement owner, product/tenant, and the outcome question. A pending plan is not approval.

checks.title: Freeze the preregistered plan
checks.instructions: Record plan artifact ID/revision, eligible unit, control/treatment IDs, allocation, primary and guardrail metric rules, minimum sample, readout window and stop rule before looking at results.

checks.title: Verify approval and action boundary
checks.instructions: Locate a dated owner decision tied to the exact plan revision and scope. Keep launch, work-tracker writes, customer contact and notifications in separately authorized routes.

checks.title: Inspect provider and rollback scope
checks.instructions: Probe the exact flag, campaign or experiment object and its current revision, allocation, exposure source, rollback owner and duplicate-launch key. A ticket or approved plan is not a launch receipt.

checks.title: Bind two distinct Crew jobs
checks.instructions: Inspect and reuse or create Experiment Run Coordinator and Growth Outcome Analyst Crew IDs with selected skills, separate output paths and least-privilege access.

checks.title: Test provider and outcome reads
checks.instructions: Have the run Crew read one representative provider state and decision record. Have the outcome Crew read exposure and primary/guardrail sources under the same experiment and tenant. Record source revisions, join coverage and missing access.

checks.title: Validate the exact execution-to-readout handoff
checks.instructions: Save a normalized frozen-experiment-plan/v1 and experiment-execution-record/v1, then run the blocking validator against both. Pending approval or missing launch receipt stops outcome claims. For a launched case, pass the checked artifact ID and save/validate experiment-outcome-readout/v1 against the plan and execution, including an inconclusive example.

checks.title: Review Builder proposal
checks.instructions: Show Crew reuse/creation, frozen plan, provider object, decision receipt, artifact paths, blocking checks, owner and readout gates. Selection creates no work item, variant, message, launch or schedule.

checks.title: Run one bounded real case
checks.instructions: With authorized records, prove either an honest pending state or a provider-confirmed launch and outcome read. Recompute counts and guardrails; review source truth and limitations with the owner.

checks.title: Choose repeat policy
checks.instructions: Record manual-only or a reviewed paused check schedule with timezone, window/source lag, query cost, retries and notifications. Completing setup never activates recurrence or external actions.
